services.heading: Expert Residential & Commercial Plumbing Services
services.subheading: Every truck is a rolling warehouse stocked with commercial-grade parts so we can solve 95% of Dallas plumbing emergencies on the very first visit.

items.title: 24/7 Emergency Plumbing
items.description: Burst pipes, overflowing toilets, or main shut-off failures? Our rapid-response Dallas crews are on call day and night with zero overtime surprises.

items.title: Drain Cleaning & Hydro-Jetting
items.description: Eliminate stubborn backups, tree root intrusions, and grease buildup permanently using HD fiber-optic sewer cameras and high-pressure hydro-jetting.

items.title: Tank & Tankless Water Heaters
items.description: Same-day repair and code-compliant installation for Rheem, Navien, and Rinnai gas or electric water heaters so your family never runs out of hot water.

items.title: Non-Invasive Slab Leak Detection
items.description: Protect your North Texas foundation. We use acoustic listening equipment and thermal imaging to pinpoint hidden under-slab leaks without wrecking your floors.

items.title: Trenchless Sewer Line Repair
items.description: Replace cracked cast-iron or clay sewer lines beneath your Dallas yard using cured-in-place pipe (CIPP) lining that preserves your driveway and landscaping.

items.title: Fixture Upgrades & Whole-Home Repiping
items.description: Upgrade low-pressure galvanized pipes to durable PEX-A or copper, and install modern faucets, garbage disposals, and smart leak-shutoff valves.

testimonials.heading: Why Dallas Homeowners Trust Lone Star Flow
testimonials.subheading: We treat your home like our own—wearing shoe covers, laying down protective drop cloths, and walking you through every option before touching a wrench.
testimonials.averageRatingText: Rated 4.9 Out of 5 Stars Across 1,400+ Local DFW Service Calls

items.author: Marcus & Elena Vance
items.comment: Our water bill tripled overnight and we heard running water behind the kitchen wall. Lone Star Flow arrived in 45 minutes, pinpointed the slab leak electronically without jackhammering our hardwood floors, and completed a clean PEX reroute the same afternoon.

items.author: Deborah Thornton
items.comment: Two other Dallas plumbing companies tried to upsell us on unnecessary electrical panel work. Lone Star Flow gave us a transparent flat-rate quote, installed our new tankless system neatly, and hauled away the rusted 50-gallon tank. Spotless workmanship!

items.author: jason K. Miller
items.comment: Main sewer line backed up on a Sunday evening before family arrived in town. Their dispatcher answered live on the second ring, the master plumber showed us the tree roots on the camera monitor, and cleared the line completely within an hour.
